name: Dive Hightide Watersports
summary: A PADI dive centre on the beach at Coral Reef Club on the west coast, running since 1993. They run boat dives to west and south coast reefs and wrecks, and teach PADI courses from first try dives to Divemaster. The crew sets up, loads and washes your gear for you.
standouts: Member of PIRA, the PADI International Resort Association (#17146)
Established in 1993 at Coral Reef Club
Founding member of the Barbados Dive Operators Association
No more than 4 students to one instructor on beginner courses

contact.address: Coral Reef Club, St. James, Barbados

trips.title: Dives – Includes All Equipment
trips.summary: Boat dives from Coral Reef Club, sold as packages of 1 to 20 dives with all equipment included. Sites run from the shallow Carlisle Bay wrecks to the Stavronikita, a 365 ft freighter sitting upright off the west coast. Night dives and Enriched Air Nitrox are available at extra cost.
highlights: Night dives with a surcharge, minimum 4 people
Enriched Air Nitrox dive at $15 per tank

prices.label: Night Dives Surcharge
prices.note: Per diver; minimum 4 people, min surcharge $120, prorata max 4 divers

trips.checkNotes: Price list says all prices in US Dollars, as of Feb 2026 (valid through to Jan 2029), subject to change. The page does not say whether package prices are per diver. Dive packages are paid in advance and non-refundable. Booking is a reservation request form on their own site that asks for card details.

trips.title: Dives – Tanks and Weights only
trips.summary: The same boat dives for divers who bring their own gear, with tanks and weights supplied. Packages run from 1 to 20 dives and cost less than the all-equipment rate.
highlights: Lower rate than the all-equipment packages
trips.checkNotes: The site heading also states a discount figure for this rate, left out here. Same price list notes as the all-equipment packages (USD, Feb 2026, paid in advance and non-refundable).

trips.title: Discover Scuba Diving
trips.summary: A first try at scuba with a PADI instructor, starting with a short briefing and practice in the pool. You then go out on the dive boat for an ocean dive to a maximum of 40 feet, with your instructor close by. You leave with a certificate that lets you join further dives at a reduced price.
highlights: Pool session before the ocean dive
Ocean dive to a depth of up to 40 feet / 12 metres
No more than 4 students to one instructor
Certificate of completion at the end
bring: Dry clothes to change back into
trips.checkNotes: Price taken from the Feb 2026 price list on /dive-shop/. The Speciality Dives page still shows $110 for this course; used the dated price list.

trips.title: Bubblemaker
trips.summary: A first taste of scuba for children, in water shallower than 2 metres. Kids use scuba gear sized for children under the direct care of a PADI professional. No experience is needed, but they must be comfortable in the water.
trips.requirements: At least 8 years old, comfortable in the water; parental approval required
trips.checkNotes: Price taken from the Feb 2026 price list on /dive-shop/. The Speciality Dives page still shows $75; used the dated price list.

trips.title: PADI SCUBA Diver Course
trips.summary: A shorter PADI certification over two days with two dives. It is priced as a course fee plus two package dives and a crew pack. A separate one-day upgrade option is also listed.

prices.label: PADI SCUBA Diver Course (2 Days, 2 Dives)
prices.note: Plus 2 package dives and crew pack $70

prices.label: PADI SCUBA Diver Upgrade (1 Days, 2 Dives)
prices.note: Plus 2 package dives and crew pack $70

trips.checkNotes: Course fee does not include the 2 package dives; the package dive price is listed separately on the same page. The page does not say what the upgrade leads to.

trips.title: PADI Open Water Diver Course
trips.summary: The full PADI Open Water certification: dive theory, pool skills, then four ocean dives from the dive boat. Pool sessions run in the mornings and ocean dives in the afternoons over two days. You can do the theory online or with a dive centre at home before you travel.
highlights: eLearning and referral options to save holiday time
Ages 10 to 12 certify as PADI Junior Open Water Divers
Small groups with direct instructor help

prices.label: PADI Open Water Course Referral (2 Days, 4 Dives)
PADI Open Water Course Referral (2 Days, 4 Dives)
PADI Open water Course e-learning referral, including pool (2 Days, 4 Dives)

trips.requirements: Minimum age 10, adequate swimming skills and good physical health. No prior scuba experience needed. Junior Open Water Divers (ages 10 to 12) are certified to a maximum of 40 feet / 12 metres.
trips.checkNotes: Prices taken from the Feb 2026 price list on /dive-shop/, which repeats some referral lines with different prices. The course page itself shows older prices ($450 for 3 days including all materials, $350 referral including pool, $320 e-learning referral, $320 referral). priceFrom is the lowest all-in course price; the $100 and $170 referral options also need 4 package dives.

trips.title: Advanced Open Water
trips.summary: The next PADI level after Open Water, run over two days with five dives. You can also do single Adventure Dives, or the one-day Adventure Diver course and upgrade it later.
highlights: Adventure Diver can be upgraded to Advanced Open Water

prices.label: PADI Adventure Diver, including manual (1 Day, 3 Dives)
PADI Adventure Diver Upgrade to PADI Advanced Open Water (1 Day, 2 Dives)

trips.checkNotes: priceFrom is the all-in Advanced Open Water price; the $85 Adventure options also need package dives and a manual.

trips.title: PADI Rescue Diver
trips.summary: The PADI Rescue Diver course, run over four days. The price includes the eLearning course code.
trips.checkNotes: The Speciality Dives page lists an Emergency First Response course (1 day, $150) at an older price; it is not on the Feb 2026 price list.

trips.title: PADI Divemaster
trips.summary: The first professional PADI level, run over eight days. The price includes the eLearning course code.

trips.title: PADI DSD Leader
trips.summary: A PADI rating for leading Discover Scuba Diving sessions, run over four half days.
trips.checkNotes: The site gives no description of this course beyond its name and price.

trips.title: Speciality Courses
trips.summary: PADI specialty courses for certified divers, from underwater photography and buoyancy to night, wreck and deep diving. Most run over one or two days, and some are priced as a course fee plus package dives.
highlights: Deep Specialty trains for dives to 40 metres / 130 feet
Wreck Specialty covers surveying, mapping and penetration lines
Enriched Air (Nitrox) Diver over 2 days, 2 dives

prices.label: Night Diver (3 Nights, 3 Dives)
prices.note: Plus surcharge (max surcharge $360, max 4 divers or $90 per diver)

trips.checkNotes: Prices from the Feb 2026 price list on /dive-shop/. The Speciality Dives page shows older prices for the same courses and also lists an Underwater Naturalist Specialty (1 day, 2 dives, $225) that is not on the current list. priceFrom is the lowest all-in specialty price; the $170 courses also need package dives and a manual.

trips.title: SCUBA Tune Up/Refresher (Theory & Pool)
trips.summary: A short refresher for divers who have not been in the water for a while. It covers theory and a pool session before you join a dive.
trips.checkNotes: Price from the Feb 2026 price list; the Speciality Dives page still shows $25.

offers.text: Group discount: I go free in 11 divers
offers.conditions: Travelling as a group, applies per person to the purchase of 2 days of 2 tank dives. Offered year-round, subject to availability.

offers.text: American Airlines AAdvantage Dive for Miles program

checkNotes: No email address appears on the site (the list has info@divehightide.com, not confirmed on their pages). Booking is a reservation request form on /reservations/ that collects card details; packages are paid in advance and non-refundable, and the cancellation policy charges part of the dive cost for late cancellations in winter and summer periods. Course pages carry older prices than the dated Feb 2026 price list; the dated list was used throughout. The Partners page says 'over 24 years', which reads as old text. The sea turtle tagging dives described on the About Barbados page have been discontinued according to the About page. Also listed on PADI Adventures per our list, not checked.
